name: critic a2r2 — P28 sound effects + mixer (audit trail)
note: Judged by audio-probe + independent DSP on the rendered WAVs, not by reading the builder's notes.

steps.note: 50 ids from Sfx.list() probed individually; one-shots at 2-6 s, ambience at 12-20 s
variants: var:<id>:1..3 for sword_hit, cursor, footstep_grass, monster_hurt
true mix: mix:battle+<id> vs mix:battle alone; pile:battle+5 impacts for headroom
ambience seams: loop:<id>:0 rendered at exactly loop.len (16 s, night 12 s), wrap derivative measured
fast-cursor mixer test: Sfx.play('cursor') every 110 ms for 2 s while sampling Audio.state().pulses.music

measurements.clipping: 0.000% on every one of the 50 effects; hottest single effect fire at -2.03 dBFS; 5 impacts piled on one millisecond peaks -0.53 dBFS (no clip, 0.5 dB margin)

transientShapes1msRmsEnvelope.sword_hit: -10 dB in 4 ms, -20 in 39 ms, -30 only at 261 ms, ends 409 ms
transientShapes1msRmsEnvelope.sword_crit: -10 dB in 6 ms, -30 in 81 ms, ends 247 ms
transientShapes1msRmsEnvelope.monster_hurt: -10 dB in 8 ms, -30 in 49 ms, ends 297 ms
transientShapes1msRmsEnvelope.player_hurt: -10 dB in 7 ms, -30 in 67 ms, ends 234 ms

swordHitTailInTrueMix.cause: blade() tail envelope pts=[[0.05,0.8],[0.14,0.7],[0.24,0.68],[0.3,0.4],[0.37,0.08]] holds two wide white-noise bands (bandpass 2400 Hz Q 0.6, g 0.5) at 68-80% of peak from 50 ms to 240 ms; sword_hit is the only impact that calls blade with tail=1

variantsSpectroTemporalSimilarity.reading: variants are jitter on one waveform, not alternate takes

ambienceLoopWraps.reading: no clicks; all four beds wrap inside the local sample-step noise

menuBlipDuckFlutter.test: cursor every 110 ms for 2 s (a child holding the d-pad)
menuBlipDuckFlutter.reading: ~9 Hz, 0 to -3.1 dB wobble on the music while scrolling a menu; DQV PS2 never ducks for a cursor pip

pitchTracks.item_get: 891 / 1172 / 1477 / 1758 Hz held (A5-D6-F#6-A6) — the DQ ta-ta-ta-taaa, correct
pitchTracks.level_up_sparkle: 1172 / 1477 / 1758 / 2344 Hz (D6-F#6-A6-D7) rising glockenspiel triad + sparkle, 1.64 s
pitchTracks.monster_defeat: 1758 -> 1313 -> 1102 Hz then holds 1102 flat for 350+ ms (steps down, then stops sliding)
pitchTracks.note: item_get and level_up_sparkle are the same D-major arpeggio; separated only by timbre

footstepMaterialSeparationAbsoluteBandsD.reading: wood has a 37 dB drop from its low band to 3-6 kHz — a hollow thud with no sole-on-board click

verdict.biggestGap: sword_hit's 250 ms bright noise tail: shorten and darken it so a hit reads as contact, not a swipe
